description: Generate the index from its topics and place it on a page, or replace the index already generated (Index panel menu > Generate Index): title and title style, nested or run-in, section headings, level, heading, page number and cross-reference styles, and every separator.

autoflow.description: Add pages and frames until the whole index is placed

layer.description: Layer to place it on (default: the active layer)

options.description: Generate Index options; only the ones given change

crossReferenceStyle.description: Character style for cross-reference words (See, See also)

crossReferenceTopicStyle.description: Character style for the referenced topic

entryEndSeparator.description: Text at the end of each entry

followingTopicSeparator.description: Separator after the topic (^t, ^> and other metacharacters work)

format.description: Nested (one line per subentry) or run-in

includeBookDocuments.description: Index every document of the book

replaceExisting.description: Replace the index already generated instead of placing a new one

x.description: Left edge in mm from the page's left edge (default: the left margin)

y.description: Top edge in mm from the page's top edge (default: the top margin)

name: generate_index
title: Generate Index
